meta.subtitle: LOX / IPA Flight Vehicle & GSE
meta.notes: MOE flight vehicle and its ground support equipment, per MOE P&ID V2.0. Valves and transducers are named by function, as on the drawing. Valve channels 1-15 are PLACEHOLDERS: the DC channel order is not decided yet. Real wiring lives in config/hardware-moe.json.

bangbang.name: Fuel Tank Press
bangbang._ventValve: Left null, as on Draco, until the board vent wiring and the sense of its vent bit are confirmed on this vehicle. The tank vents here are normally open, so a wrong sense would reopen a vent the operator just closed.

bangbang.name: LOX Tank Press
bangbang._ventValve: Left null, as on Draco, until the board vent wiring and the sense of its vent bit are confirmed on this vehicle. The tank vents here are normally open, so a wrong sense would reopen a vent the operator just closed.

autosequences.name: Safe All
autosequences.description: Command every actuator to its configured safe state.

steps.message: Driving all actuators to safe state

autosequences.name: HOT FIRE (5s)
autosequences.description: Ox lead, 5 s burn, cutoff. Fill both tanks and bring them to pressure first: the main valves stroke on the actuator bus, which is regulated off the LOX tank, so they cannot open on an unpressurized vehicle. Ignition is external.

steps.message: HOT FIRE COMPLETE — tanks still pressurized, detank when ready

autosequences.name: Detank / Post-Test
autosequences.description: Controllers off, press valves shut, both tanks vented down.

autosequences.name: ABORT
autosequences.description: Emergency safing: mains closed, press closed, tank vents open, ground fills shut.

steps.message: Abort state reached — vehicle is venting
